extraction.document_summary: GREAT Hospital Cash is a standalone health insurance plan that pays cash benefits when the Life Assured is hospitalised for illness or injury, and when additional intensive care, post-surgery, or (for some plans) day surgery events occur. The core cash mechanic is: if hospitalisation lasts for 12 consecutive hours or longer (or involves room-and-board charges), you receive a Daily Hospital Cash Benefit. The daily amount depends on the plan tier: Plan A pays S$100/day, Plan B S$200/day, Plan C S$400/day, and Plan D S$600/day, with coverage “up to 730 days per Hospitalisation”. If the Life Assured is in ICU, an extra Daily Hospital Cash Benefit applies up to 60 days (“Additional Daily Hospital Cash Benefit - Intensive Care Unit”). The plan also includes a Get Well Benefit: hospitalisation lump sum of up to S$1,800 per hospitalisation (at least 3 days of room-and-board charges), plus a separate post-surgery lump sum (excluding day surgery) up to S$1,800. It further provides Emergency Accidental Outpatient reimbursement of up to S$100/200/400/600 per period of insurance, but treatment must be given within 72 hours of the accident.
quality_notes: Brochure contains clear benefit names, plan tiers (Plan A–D), and multiple numeric benefit caps.
Some underwriting/eligibility fields (e.g., entry ages) are not stated beyond “All ages specified refer to age next birthday”.
The document provides definitions for hospitalisation requirements and limits (12 hours / room & board; ICU limit of 60 days; illness/injury daily benefit up to 730 days).

policies.quick_summary: GREAT Hospital Cash pays cash for hospitalisation after a minimum qualifying period (12 hours or room & board charges), with higher payouts for ICU and additional lump sums for qualifying hospitalisation and surgery-related events. It also reimburses certain emergency outpatient treatment following an accident. The plan is offered in four tiers (Plan A–D), with Daily Hospital Cash Benefit ranging from S$100/day to S$600/day and Get Well Benefit amounts up to S$1,800 per hospitalisation (subject to the stated conditions and limits). Day surgery has separate (lower) lump sum amounts. ICU cash is capped at 60 days per hospitalisation.
coverage_scope: Illness/Injury hospitalisation cash payouts after minimum qualifying hospitalisation time
Additional cash for ICU hospitalisation (up to stated limit)
Lump sum Get Well Benefit for hospitalisation with at least 3 days of room & board charges
Lump sum Get Well Benefit for post-surgery (excluding day surgery)
Lump sum Get Well Benefit for day surgery
Emergency accidental outpatient medical treatment reimbursement (reimbursement basis) after accident
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages specified refer to age next birthday.
policies.renewal_basis: Subject to the terms of renewal.
important_caveats: Hospitalisation must meet the stated definition (12 consecutive hours or longer; or room and board charge) and must be considered Medically Necessary.
Emergency accidental outpatient treatment must be given within 72 hours of the occurrence of the accident.
Post-Surgery Get Well Benefit excludes day surgery.
ICU Additional Daily Hospital Cash Benefit is payable each ICU day up to a maximum period of 60 days for each hospitalisation; ICU beyond 60 days is treated as a normal ward for benefit purposes.

benefits.benefit_name: Daily Hospital Cash Benefit – Illness / Injury
benefits.benefit_description: Pays a daily cash amount when the Life Assured is hospitalised for illness or injury, after the qualifying hospitalisation requirement is met.
benefits.trigger_description: Hospitalisation for illness or injury meeting the stated hospitalisation definition; hospitalisation refers to medically necessary confinement in a hospital or at home under Virtual Hospital Ward admission by a Restructured Hospital.
covered_conditions: Hospitalisation for 12 consecutive hours or longer; or for which a room and board charge is made in connection with such confinement.
Hospitalisation must be considered Medically Necessary.
benefits.payout_description: Benefit amount depends on plan tier (Plan A–D). Up to 730 days per Hospitalisation.
benefits.benefit_start_description: Assurance of hospital cash payouts after 12 hours.
benefits.notes: Daily Hospital Cash Benefit – Illness / Injury is shown as a plan-tier per-day amount in the table; exact plan amounts are captured in plans.

evidence.quote: Receive up to S$600 per day when you are hospitalised for 12 hours^ or longer.

(Up to 730 days per Hospitalisation^)

Restructured Hospital, which must be considered Medically Necessary and:
 (a) for 12 consecutive hours or longer; or (b) for which a room and board charge is made in connection with such conﬁnement.

benefits.benefit_description: Pays an additional daily cash amount for each day the Life Assured undergoes hospitalisation in an ICU (in addition to the daily hospital cash).
benefits.trigger_description: ICU hospitalisation due to illness or injury, subject to the ICU daily limit per hospitalisation.
covered_conditions: Hospitalisation in an ICU due to an illness or injury.
ICU hospitalisation day count limit applies.
benefits.payout_description: Additional daily benefit is payable up to 60 days for each hospitalisation; ICU beyond 60 days treated as normal ward.
benefits.notes: Plan-tier ICU additional daily amounts are captured in plans.
